subject: Post-demo: clarifying SLAs, hosting & procurement path
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@medexa.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medexa.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Aug 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: clarifying SLAs, hosting & procurement path

Thanks again for your time today — quick recap and three clarifying questions so we can line up the right procurement package and PoC scope.

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Primary goal: surface-time-sensitive clinical triage suggestions inside Medexa's intake workflow.
- Traffic profile: ~600 qps peak for inference, median request size ~180 tokens, 95th token length ~420 tokens.
- Security: must run in customer VPC (private deployment) for PHI handling.

Clarifying asks (can you confirm by EOD Tue?):
1) Latency targets: you mentioned P95 under consumer-facing budget. Can you confirm the P95 target (for 256-token requests) that would be considered acceptable for launch? Our initial math says ~120ms P95 on a dedicated private pool is achievable but we want to validate your bar.
2) Cost envelope: procurement wants a rough per-1k-requests cost band to evaluate economics vs on-prem alternatives — is <$0.50 per 1k inference requests (token-normalized) a meaningful target?
3) Procurement gating: who is the econ buyer and who owns the procurement/legal loop? You mentioned Raj owns the procurement pack; can you share the procurement contact and a preferred timeline for vendor questionnaire (SOC2 evidence, DPA, insurance)?

Attachments: I included a short CSV mapping SLA/cost tradeoffs for the three hosting options (hosted API / dedicated / private VPC). Also attached a template SOC2 evidence checklist you can share with procurement.

Suggested next steps:
- Medexa to confirm P95 target + procurement contact (Hannah/Raj) — action: Medexa (Hannah) — by Tue 9/2
- Redwood to prepare a scoped PoC plan (3 weeks) and a draft commercial term sheet for the preferred host option — action: Connor & Karthik — by Fri 9/5
- Redwood to run internal sizing and flag any blockers for private deployment (networking/KMS) — action: Marissa — by Mon 9/8

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that's easier to resolve these three bullets.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@medexa.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medexa.com>, Medexa Procurement <procurement@medexa.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: clarifying SLAs, hosting & procurement path

Connor — good notes and thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick answers: 

1) Latency: our target for go-live is P95 <= 150ms for 256-token requests. If you can hit 120ms that's great but we can plan to accept up to 150ms as the committee's threshold.
2) Cost: procurement prefers to see per-seat or per-1k-call comparisons. <$0.50 per 1k would be compelling; please include token-normalized and request-normalized numbers in your table.
3) Procurement/contact: Raj (cc) is coordinating the procurement packet. Procurement inbox is on the cc. We need SOC2 Type II evidence, a DPA, and network topology docs for the private VPC deployment. Timeline: procurement review starts week of 9/8, final vendor approval expected by end of September if the PoC goes well.

Notes on deployment mode: Security has mandated private VPC (not hosted shared multitenant) for the triage flow that touches PHI. We may evaluate a hybrid approach (dedicated + VPC peering) for cost reasons but the legal team will push for full VPC if PHI scope remains large.

We're happy to proceed with your PoC plan; can you share a concise 1-2 page PoC scope + data handling flow and the SLA/cost matrix?

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Clinical Product
Medexa Labs
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@medexa.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medexa.com>, Medexa Procurement <procurement@medexa.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: clarifying SLAs, hosting & procurement path

Appreciate the fast responses — confirming items and delivering the PoC/attachments as requested. See inline summary and attached CSV + SOC2 checklist.

Inline confirmation: 
- Latency: committee threshold P95 <= 150ms for 256 tokens; Redwood will size for a 120ms target in the PoC to give headroom.
- Cost: we'll provide both token-normalized and request-normalized cost bands; we'll highlight where batching/kv-caching can materially reduce token costs.
- Deployment: default = private VPC (required by security). We'll also outline a hybrid dedicated+peering option with delta in cost/SLA.
- Procurement: Raj and Medexa Procurement will be the reviewers; we'll surface SOC2 evidence, DPA template, and network diagram.

PoC & commercial cadence we propose:
1) PoC scope doc (attached) — 3-week run in Medexa VPC with sample traffic (synthetic + 48h live shadow) — deliverable: performance report + latency/cost profile. Owner: Connor & Karthik — deliver by Fri 9/5.
2) Procurement pack: SOC2 pack + DPA + draft MSA redline. Owner: Marissa — deliver by Tue 9/9.
3) Exec econ review: Redwood to provide per-1k-request and per-token cost bands (hosted/dedicated/private) and a short runbook for autoscaling and rollback thresholds. Owner: Connor — deliver by Tue 9/9.

Action items for Medexa: share any mandatory contract clauses or minimum insurance limits that procurement enforces; also confirm preferred PoC start window (week of 9/8 looks feasible on our side).

Attachments in this thread:
- redwood-sla-and-cost-summary.csv (SLA p95/p99 assumptions, sample unit economics)
- medexa-soc2-evidence-request.pdf (SOC2 checklist to help procurement)

If you'd like, Karthik can join a 20-min call on Wed 9/3 to walk through the PoC tech plan and network requirements.

Regards,
Connor

To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: next steps & quick asks from procurement

Karthik / Marissa — internal follow-up after Medexa confirmed targets. Keep this short: 

1) Karthik: please draft the PoC tech plan (1 page) and include the network checklist for private VPC (subnet, NAT, peering, KMS for keys, egress rules). Medexa will need that for their infra team — target EOD Fri 9/5. Add a short note on caching/batching settings we should test to hit the 120ms P95 target.
2) Marissa: prepare the procurement pack — SOC2 evidence links, DPA template, and a first-pass MSA redline. Also include insurance and indemnity language options (they may push for higher liability caps given PHI). Target Tue 9/9.
3) I'll schedule the 20-min architecture sync for Wed 9/3 at 11:00am PT with Hannah & Raj (tentative). Please keep that slot free.

Also, log this as a potential private-deployment deal in HubSpot (deal MW-1247) and flag as moderate procurement friction (SOC2 + PHI).

Thanks — Connor
